context: Ren interviews a researcher about study results.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: research interview; vocabulary (成果/証拠/防止/分類/品質) in natural home.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 研究の成果は、まとまりましたか?
lines.en: Have the research results come together?
lines.style: engaged young interviewer voice, soft warm curious focus throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、確かな証拠が得られました。
lines.style: composed researcher voice, soft warm measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: その証拠は、何を防止しますか?
lines.en: What does that evidence help prevent?
lines.style: curious young interviewer voice, soft warm focus throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 事故の防止に、役立ちます。
lines.style: patient researcher voice, soft warm measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: データの分類は、難しかったですか?
lines.style: engaged young interviewer voice, soft warm focus throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 品質ごとに分類して、整理しました。
lines.en: We classified and organized it by quality.
lines.style: composed researcher voice, soft warm measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 品質が高いと、成果も確かですね。
lines.style: understanding young interviewer voice, soft warm focus throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 防止の成果を、社会に届けたいです。
lines.en: I want to deliver the prevention results to society.
lines.style: warm researcher voice, soft warm measured closing clarity throughout
